LeaderboardScore.title: LeaderboardScore
LeaderboardScore.description: A player's memory card game score entry with their Name and Royal or Rebel destiny alignment.

playerName.description: Public display name shown on the global leaderboard (no PII).

alignment.description: Whether the player chose Royal or Rebel destiny.

score.description: Calculated final round score between 0 and 50000.

bracket.description: Composite mode and difficulty bracket key used for indexed single-field real-time queries.

moves.description: Total pair flip attempts taken to clear the board.

timeSeconds.description: Elapsed time in seconds to complete the round.

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive pair match streak during the round.

themeName.description: Deck theme used during the round.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score entry was recorded.

/leaderboard_entries/{entryId}.description: Real-time global leaderboard score entries keyed by entryId.
